central_scientific_conclusion: ZERO_PUBLIC_UNGATED_GENAI_DOCUMENT_DATASETS: All verified Generative AI document datasets (AIForge-Doc, GPT4o-Receipt) require authenticated access (gated: auto, HTTP 401 Unauthorized); whereas all publicly ungated document forgery datasets (TDoc-2.8M, RealText-V2-Syn25k, FSTS) consist of traditional non-AI manipulations (copy-move, splicing, synthetic font insertion, or Fourier series modeling of Photoshop traces). Therefore, in compliance with Scientific Honesty, the system fails-closed safely without downloading non-AI datasets or bypassing authentication gates, and provides an actionable fallback design for an independent controlled document pilot.

candidates.name: AIForge-Doc (v1 & v2)
candidates.scope_details: 4,061 images of financial and form documents (CORD, WildReceipt, SROIE, XFUND)
candidates.generator_provenance: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, Ideogram v2 Edit, GPT-Image-2 diffusion/inpaint pipelines
candidates.authentic_source: Original benchmark documents from CORD, SROIE, WildReceipt, XFUND
candidates.pairing_details: 1:1 exact matching in TestingSet (812 authentic + 812 forged + 812 ground-truth masks)
candidates.status_explanation: Repo is configured as gated: auto on Hugging Face Hub; returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized without approved token.

candidates.name: GPT4o-Receipt
candidates.authentic_source: ExpressExpense and Roboflow Universe public receipts
candidates.pairing_details: Unpaired independent collections (935 synthetic receipts + 300 independent real receipts)
candidates.status_explanation: Repo is configured as gated: auto on Hugging Face Hub; returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized without approved token.

candidates.name: TDoc-2.8M
candidates.generator_provenance: Contrastive learning similarity-guided crop-and-paste (copy-move, splicing, synthetic text insertion)
candidates.authentic_source: Authentic clean source crops mixed inside generation pipeline; public shards contain only tampered outputs
candidates.pairing_details: Sharded tar archives of tampered documents; authentic originals not distributed as paired controls
candidates.status_explanation: Uses classical crop-and-paste / splicing / insertion rules; not Generative AI (no diffusion / autoregressive generative models).

candidates.name: RealText-V2-Syn25k
candidates.scope_details: 25,028 synthetic forged document images generated from RealText-V2 clean samples
candidates.generator_provenance: Similarity-guided synthetic pipeline (copy-move, splicing, coverage, insertion, classical inpainting)
candidates.authentic_source: Derived from RealText-V2 authentic subset (6,000 images)
candidates.pairing_details: Forged images generated from clean RealText-V2 images
candidates.status_explanation: Forged instances are created via automated copy-move, splicing, and font insertion; not Generative AI.

candidates.name: FSTS (Fourier Series-based Tampering Synthesis)
candidates.scope_details: 16,750 text tampering instances across document and scene images
candidates.generator_provenance: Fourier series mathematical modeling of manual human Photoshop/PSD editing traces
candidates.pairing_details: Paired authentic, tampered, and tampering masks
candidates.status_explanation: Synthesizes mathematical approximations of Photoshop editing traces; not Generative AI inpainting or generation.
